title: Service definitions record a stable Node executable
goal: Resolve the Node path at install to a stable target, tested on all three service definitions
acceptance: A committed test with a per-shell (fnm-style) path fails before the fix
Install writes the resolved stable path or refuses with a clear message
launchd and systemd definitions follow the same rule
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no real paths, tokens or machine data in git.
validation: A committed test fails before the fix
escalation: A change to a model or time limit needs measured evidence that it fits

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-12: path resolution plus one test per service definition. Not a measurement.
